name: CAP flight cap insignia, officers and general officers
size_basis: Same art as the officer service device scaled to ~1.15 in wide: on the Attachment 5 flight-cap figure (p.139) the officer device is ~48 px against the 64 px "1 1/2 in" mark. The regulation gives no dimension.
provenance: CAPR 39-1 3 Mar 2020 Fig A5-8 (p.138, CAP DEVICES row; A5-9 shows the same devices on the women's caps) and p.139 (flight caps); source figure is ~190 px of faint grey embossing: outline and large shading traced, no feather or leaf detail; CAP disc / shield and triangle are parametric

mounts.uniform: USAF-style flight cap (Class A / Class B / FDU), officers incl. general officers
mounts.rule: front left flap, centred halfway between the top and bottom of the flap, 1 1/2 in from the front of the cap (6.2.2.2.1); Senior Member NCOs wear the NCO device (ICL 25-02), cadet NCOs/airmen the cap-device-nco-flight, cadet officers regular or miniature metal grade (6.2.2.2.2-3)

documented: officers wear the flight cap insignia on the front left flap (6.2.2.2.1)
